name: @mooter/spawn-orchestrator
description: Mooter Spawn Orchestrator (Wave 33.5 Block B) — local-first agent spawning by default. Each spawn runs in an isolated git worktree inside a 4-layer sandbox (network egress · filesystem boundary · secrets scoping · config protection) via bubblewrap (Linux/WSL2) or Apple Seatbelt (macOS, documented). Tier is chosen by classify.js; T0/T1 → Ollama, T2/T3 → cloud. No unsandboxed mode (security wins). I/O injectable for tests.
